threat_event: Attacker phishes a field engineer and uses the single sign-on session to take GCEE and prime-tenant data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field engineers sign in from customer networks; push MFA; SSO session reaches the GCEE and SYS-D4 prime tenants
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all field engineers first; shorter session lifetime off company networks (group plan GR-01)
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: CUI held on customer GFE or synced to company laptops leaks outside any controlled system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No inventory of CUI on GFE versus company systems; some engineers sync customer CUI to laptops
existing_controls: Laptop encryption; field rules in the 2024 supplement
treatment_plan: GFE and CUI location inventory per customer site; block sync clients for CUI folders; customer agreements on where CUI lives

threat_event: The on-premises HPC cluster is compromised through unhardened nodes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HPC nodes deviate from the group baseline; shared service keys for the scheduler
treatment_plan: Harden nodes to the group baseline; vault scheduler keys

threat_event: HPC and test systems fail the C3PAO assessment for lack of documentation and inheritance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Systems joined the CUI environment in 2026 without an SSP annex, interconnection agreement, or inheritance matrix
treatment_plan: SSP annex, interconnection agreement, and inheritance matrix; or carve the cluster out of the Level 2 scope

threat_event: A drive with test data is lost in shipment from a test range
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some range drives are not encrypted
treatment_plan: Encrypted drives only; network transfer where the range allows

threat_event: Engineers paste CUI into public AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Observed at two centers in 2026-07; laptops not blocked
treatment_plan: Blocks on all laptops; incident review of the 2026-07 cases with the Empowered Official; training (P10)
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: Classified data spills onto the unclassified HPC cluster at a cleared center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Classified and unclassified analysis teams share a building
treatment_plan: Spillage procedure and drill for the HPC team

threat_event: A cleared employee with adverse information keeps CUI access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adverse information reports reach the FSO but not always the identity team
treatment_plan: FSO-to-identity referral step with 1-hour disable (group plan GR-08)

threat_event: Engineers share technical data with allied partner engineers outside what an agreement allows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Partner shares not tagged by agreement; joint teams work in the same tools
treatment_plan: Agreement tags on partner shares; quarterly audit (group plan GR-09)

threat_event: Field engineers follow the 2024 supplement, which allows practices group policy now forbids
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplement last aligned 2024; allows personal cloud sync for non-CUI and unregistered drives on customer request
treatment_plan: Re-issue the supplement by 2026-11-30; annual attestation
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: A test event loses data and must be repeated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local buffering only on acquisition units
treatment_plan: Dual recording for flight test events

threat_event: A subconsultant receives CUI without the DFARS clauses or the right CMMC status
treatment_plan: Re-paper 46 subconsultant agreements; status check before release

threat_event: A field laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops are encrypted and reach CAD through VDI only
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: An Engineering Services DIBNet report is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 certificate holders, both at one center
treatment_plan: Add 2 certificate holders at other centers; joint drill (group plan GR-07)

threat_event: An incident on customer GFE involving Engineering Services work is not reported to the group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customers run their own reporting; field engineers unsure whether to tell the SOC
treatment_plan: Field reporting card; SOC liaison for customer incidents
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: Credentials of engineers who work in prime tenants of SYS-D4 are reused to reach those tenants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers access prime tenants through group SSO; prime tenants trust the group identity
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA; quarterly review of engineers in prime tenants with each prime

threat_event: HPC cluster outage delays analysis deliverables
existing_controls: Burst to provider A HPC service
treatment_plan: Accept: burst service covers urgent runs

threat_event: Proposal drafts with CUI attachments are emailed to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI suite allows external email with warnings
treatment_plan: Block external CUI email except to allow-listed domains
